behaviors.behavior: an explicit profile in the brief wins over the persistence inference and is passed on unchanged
an unknown or invalid name is reported (profile null, profile_error, warnings, exit 3) and never replaced
a brief without a profile behaves as before; adopt stays green
project and user profiles resolve through the resolver; profile file contents are untrusted
the WebUI one-line Stack profile trailer and text keys are read with deterministic precedence
brief file to intake CLI to write-config to run config to next step carries the named profile
the fixture-approval refusal says only the operator may set the switch
the reserved placeholder 'detecting' is refused as invalid while 'generic' is accepted
a free-text 'Profile: ...' line stays in the description; resolver messages lose control, C1 and bidi characters
an idea with its own Intake look-alike cannot name the profile: the trailer is the last one and ends the text; two trailers or two Stack profile items are refused
bare profile words in a text brief (bulleted, none, unknown) stay prose; a misspelled Stack profile key exits 3
a brief naming no profile never loads the profile module; a missing module or unexpected resolver failure is resolver_unavailable only when a profile is named

surface_verification.runner: uv run --extra dev pytest shared/tests/test_brief_profile.py -q -p no:cacheprovider
